{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''Phalderi''' was a group of three [[modular conveyor]]s that were part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]]. Two of the freighters were carrying [[Droid/Legends|droids]], while the third one was carrying [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]]. The one with the warheads was destroyed by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during their [[Mission to Almaran|recon mission]] of the Imperial fleet.
